cohort: 40 patients aged 18-35 years with pre-eclampsia and/or eclampsia from a total of 1236 deliveries, at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology of a tertiary care hospital in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, from July 2021 to July 2022
finding: The study found an incidence of pre-eclampsia or eclampsia of 3.23%, with the majority occurring before childbirth and in first-time mothers, highlighting the need for early detection and management of hypertensive disorders during pregnancy.
